actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.

inputs.description: Camera selector; this package serves one configured camera, so the value is accepted and does not change the connection
inputs.name: camera

actions.name: capture

adjusts.description: Exposure time in microseconds; the next capture applies it
adjusts.name: exposure_time_us

adjusts.description: Gain on the camera's own unitless scale; the next capture applies it
adjusts.name: gain

facts.text: The clone's module comment makes BaumerGenICam.capture the primary capture path, called by mcp_server.loop_tools.get_image()
BaumerGenICam is capture-only and explicitly has no stage control
The constructor finds GenTL .cti producers and raises RuntimeError when no producer or no camera is found; it then creates and starts one acquirer
get_settings reads the live GenICam node map: ExposureTime value and min/max, Gain value and min/max, PixelFormat and, when exposed, BalanceWhiteAuto
The get_settings docstring records a live VCXU-23C ExposureTime range of 28 to 60,000,000 us and a unitless Gain range of 1.0 to 251.1875
set_settings forces ExposureAuto and GainAuto to Off and raises ValueError, never clamping, when a requested exposure or gain is outside the camera-reported range
capture drains queued frames, fetches a live frame with a 5 s timeout, dispatches on PixelFormat and saves an RGB PNG named with a timestamp and the capture count
capture supports BGR8, RGB8, Mono8 and Bayer formats and raises RuntimeError for any other PixelFormat
close stops and destroys the acquirer and resets the harvester
The constructor creates the acquirer with harvester.create(0) and starts it
capture's drain loop fetches with a 0.01 s timeout and leaves the loop only when a fetch raises
The README describes an MCP server for a Nikon Ti2-E microscope and a Baumer GenICam camera
CAPTURE_DIR is acquisition.paths.captures_dir(), so the output directory follows the upstream data-root selection rather than this driver
The camera path depends on the optional harvesters, genicam and opencv-python packages

measures.name: exposure_time_range_us

measures.name: gain_range

measures.name: pixel_format

measures.name: balance_white_auto

safe_state.description: the GenTL acquirer is stopped and destroyed by BaumerGenICam.close, so no further frame is requested; nothing re-creates it, so reads and captures fail until the backend is loaded again
